name: Anchor
author: Ryan Ghods
description: Portfolio pulse, incoming offers and closing deadlines from Anchor's local read-only data service

barWidget.description: Portfolio value, incoming offers, closing deadlines and recent activity, read from Anchor's local data service on loopback. Read-only: it never signs, writes or holds a key.

schema.label: Service port
schema.description: Loopback port Anchor's data service listens on. Must match `port` in ~/.config/anchor/config.json.

schema.label: Change over
schema.description: Window the percentage change is measured across.

schema.label: Show portfolio value
schema.description: Turn off to keep the number off the bar while screen sharing. Offers and deadlines still show, and the value stays available in the panel.

schema.label: Deadline window (hours)
schema.description: Only count down offers closing within this many hours. Further out is not news.

schema.label: Urgent within (hours)
schema.description: A countdown inside this window is drawn in the theme's attention colour.

schema.label: Name length
schema.description: Characters of a collection or item name to show before truncating.
